docs.text: venmo is currently moving from west coast to Great Lakes area, not in desperate need but always appreciative
Right? I'm retiring and people keep asking if I'm moving somewhere warmer. Why would I move away from the Great Lakes?
Great Lakes is pretty chill tho…. Please nobody move here

Got recommended a YouTube video about why so many people are leaving the Great Lakes states. Too bad! You'll come crawling back to us when the dumb and hot place you moved runs out of fresh water in like 15 years!!!!

I’ve moved myself 5 times now post-college. It is a bit of a PITA, granted, but not that bad. If you are frustrated with high cost of living areas and worried about the effects of climate change, no better place to go than the Great Lakes.

Watched one video on YouTube about Black people traveling abroad, and now YouTube thinks I want to move abroad for good. I'm not getting on a boat or plane, I won't live where they have hurricanes, live under sea level, or leave the Great Lakes region. Except Mexico for the winter. Maybe...
I hear you, I am stressing thinking about figuring out how to migrate if/when the time comes. But the idea of a Great Lakes community is a sweet one!

Expatriot? From…? And you can move if you hate it. Usually the movers are selfish pricks who take and take but complain about taxes, hence FL. If you’re in IN or whatever and it’s too conservative for you, then move. Notice all the D govs in the Great Lakes states?
Good migration conditions for the next several days! Expect an uptick in new arrivals… and likely some more rarities! Lots of good stuff around the Great Lakes
Anyway, as I’ve been saying to friends and strangers alike for the last decade, everyone should be moving to, not from, the Great Lakes.
You’re doing a lot of work to convince me that no, I would not enjoy moving to the Great Lakes area. But I’m not sure how long I’ll be able to stay in Texas.

So start thinking about it. I open the floor for questions, but please don't tell me anything covered above. And please go through that ProPublica migration guide. Tldr is that the Northeast and Great Lakes are where you should move. But I don't want to "tell you what to do!" Thanks

I've been to Iowa City for the #ExaminedLife conference, which is great, but I like large bodies of water, which Iowa sorely lacks. And there's not much culture for single people in their 40s, all undergrad bars. If I were to move, I'd want to live close to either an #ocean or the #GreatLakes.
I just want to pick up Georgia and move it to the Great Lakes or something
I would shift Door County from Northwoods to Great Lakes but that's my only suggestion
Well I learned my limits after that out-of-state move out attempt. Next time, I'll try my hand at moving to a rather productive city that is near The Great Lakes.

Spicy fact check: You moved to Atlanta because it's trendy and warmer, correct? You could get a job anywhere, it's just that you wanted to live in Atlanta! All good though. Georgia is an important Swing State. To save the nation we must consider the Great Lakes to be as cool as Atlanta!
